statements.notes: Table row from the Consolidated Statement of Operations rather than a sentence. $17.3m is for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 (Q2 FY26), not the full fiscal year; $7.3m is the prior quarter (Q1 FY26). Total revenue for the quarter was $184.7m.

statements.quote: Targeted 140k GPU expansion on track to deliver $3.4bn ARR by end of CY26
statements.notes: Highlight bullet rather than a full sentence. Annualized run-rate (ARR) target for AI Cloud, not reported fiscal-year revenue. 'CY26' is calendar 2026; IREN's fiscal year ends June 30, so end of CY26 falls within fiscal 2027. Footnote 2 (p04) breaks it down as $1.94bn expected average annual revenue from the Microsoft contract plus an estimated $1.5bn from British Columbia, and says it is not fully contracted.

statements.quote: British Columbia AI Cloud expansion ongoing, with ~$0.4bn ARR now under contract for Prince George and remaining contract negotiations supporting >$0.5bn ARR3
statements.notes: Highlight bullet. The ~$0.4bn is contracted annualized AI Cloud run-rate at Prince George; per footnote 3 it includes amounts not yet generating revenue. The '3' at the end is a footnote marker. The >$0.5bn figure is under negotiation and is not recorded. This is part of the $3.4bn ARR target, not in addition to it.

statements.quote: Together with Microsoft prepayment ($1.9bn) covers 95% of GPU-related capex
statements.notes: Refers to GPU (AI) capex for the Microsoft contract, but no capex amount is stated. The 95% is the share of that capex covered by funding ($3.6bn GPU financing plus the $1.9bn prepayment), not the AI share of capex. Recorded as qualitative; no figure is derived.
